wods.title: Ignition
wods.scaled_short: 300 m run · KB 16/12 kg · ring rows instead of pull-ups
wods.nogear_short: Jump squats instead of swings · burpees instead of pull-ups
wods.hook: Day 1. Three rounds. Nowhere to hide. 🔥
wods.story: A short, honest Monday opener. Run, swing, pull — nothing fancy, just enough to wake up the whole body and set the tone for the week.
wods.tip: Treat the 400 m as a strong jog, not a sprint. You win this workout by going straight into the swings without standing around.
wods.question: What was your time — and which round hurt the most?

wods.title: Clockwork
wods.scheme: Every minute on the minute, 4 rounds:
wods.scaled_short: 10 wall balls 6/4 kg · knee raises · 10/8 cal · DB 15/10 kg
wods.hook: No pacing decisions today. The clock is your coach. ⏱️
wods.story: Four stations, sixteen minutes, zero thinking. EMOMs are perfect when your head is busy — just show up for every minute and the work takes care of itself.
wods.tip: If you finish with less than 10 seconds of rest, drop 2 reps next round. Quality beats survival.
wods.question: Did you hit every minute, or did the row get you? 😅

wods.title: Long Game
wods.scheme: As many rounds as possible in 20 min:

plan.stimulus: A pacing test. Pick a speed you can hold for 20 minutes and keep every round within 10 seconds of your first one.
tips: Cleans: switch to quick singles from round 3 — before fatigue makes the choice for you.
Push-ups: break early (6 + 4) instead of grinding to failure.
The run is your recovery. Breathe, shake out the arms, go again.

wods.hook: Mid-week AMRAP. The goal isn't to start fast — it's to finish strong. 🧠
wods.story: A barbell, the floor and a short run. Simple pieces, but twenty minutes of them teaches you more about pacing than any long explanation could. Swipe for the scaling options and the game plan →
wods.tip: Write your round count on the wall after every lap. Seeing the number keeps you honest.
wods.question: How many rounds did you get? Drop it below and let's compare

wods.title: Stairway
wods.hook: Easy start. Then it isn't. How high can you climb? 🪜
wods.story: The first rounds feel like a warm-up — that's the trap. Every rung adds two reps, and somewhere around 10 the ladder starts asking real questions.
wods.tip: Keep the deadlifts touch-and-go only while your back stays flat. The moment it rounds, switch to quick singles.
wods.question: Which rung did you finish on?

wods.title: Buddy System
wods.scheme: For time · split reps any way · one works at a time:
wods.scaled_short: 80 WB 6/4 kg · 60 cal · 40 burpees · ring rows
wods.nogear_short: Air squats · 800 m relay run · push-ups

plan.heading: HOW IT WORKS
plan.stimulus: Two people, one clock. Only one partner works at a time — the other rests, counts and decides when to switch.
tips: Switch every 10 wall balls / 10 cal. Short sets keep you both fast.
The resting partner counts reps out loud and calls the switch.
Synchro burpees: both chests down, both jump together. No sync, no rep.

wods.hook: Friday = bring a friend. Tag the person who's suffering with you today 👇
wods.story: Grab a friend, a training partner, your sibling — anyone who'll high-five you at the end. Split the work however you like. The synchro burpees at the end? Those you do together.
wods.tip: Plan your switches before the clock starts. Teams that talk less and switch more always finish faster.
wods.question: Who's your partner for this one? Tag them
wods.cta: Save it for Friday ⬇️ Post your team time in the comments.

wods.title: Race Pace
wods.scheme: For time · run 1 km before every station:
wods.scaled_short: 600 m runs · 500 m ski/row · 50 wall balls
wods.nogear_short: Burpee broad jumps · lunges · burpees · air squats between 1 km runs

plan.heading: RACE PLAN
plan.stimulus: Half a race, full lessons. This is about running well on tired legs — the skill that decides every HYROX finish.
tips: Run every 1 km at the same pace. Write your splits; the last one tells the truth.
Ski and row at a pace you can breathe through — they're not the place to win time.
Wall balls: big sets early (25–20–15–15), short breaks, never a long stop.

wods.hook: Saturday is race day. Your legs just don't know it yet. 🏁
wods.story: Training for HYROX — or just want a long, steady sweat? Four runs, four stations, one rhythm. Swipe for the scaling and the race plan →
wods.tip: The first run should feel too easy. If it doesn't, you're going too fast.
wods.question: Racing HYROX this season? Tell us your division and target time

wods.title: Sunday Eights
wods.scheme: 8 × (20 s work / 10 s rest) each · 1 min rest between:
wods.scaled_short: Air squats · knee push-ups · tuck hold · step-back burpees
wods.nogear_short: Already zero gear — living room, park, hotel room.
wods.hook: Sunday. 16 minutes. Anywhere. No excuses left. 🌤️
wods.story: No gym, no gear, no problem. Put a timer on your phone, clear a square of floor and give it sixteen honest minutes. Then go enjoy your Sunday.
wods.tip: Count every round and write down the lowest number for each movement. Your score is the sum — so don't blow up in round one.
wods.question: Where did you do it today — home, park, or hotel room?
